facts.text: The resort is located on the Green Mountain, about two hours' drive inland from Muscat, with dramatic canyon views.
facts.excerpt: Escape to cool mountain climes two hours' drive inland from Muscat. Located on the fabled Green Mountain, elevated luxury reveals dramatic canyon views at one of the world’s highest resorts.

facts.text: The resort is set high in the Al Hajar Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Set high in the Al Hajar Mountains, the resort offers breathtaking canyon views

facts.text: Guests can stargaze from the viewing platform where Princess Diana once stood.
facts.excerpt: Stargaze from the viewing platform where Princess Diana once stood.

facts.text: All rooms look out onto the canyon and have balconies.
facts.excerpt: All rooms look out onto the dramatic canyon, with comfortable balconies for viewing pleasure.

facts.text: Rooms have a dressing room and a spa-like bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Dressing room and a spa-like bathroom

facts.text: Villas have one, two or three bedrooms and a private pool, set in garden surrounds or with an infinity view across the canyon.
facts.excerpt: Slip into your private pool in exotic garden surrounds, or with an infinity view across the canyon.

facts.text: Villas come with Villa Host service.
facts.excerpt: Villa Host service

facts.text: The Anantara Spa offers traditional Thai healing and wellness journeys.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Spa with traditional Thai healing and wellness journeys

facts.text: Guests can unwind with spa and hammam rituals.
facts.excerpt: Unwind at our Oman resort with spa and hammam rituals.

facts.text: The resort has temperature-controlled swimming pools and a fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy a range of luxury facilities, including temperature-controlled swimming pools, an award-winning spa, a fitness centre

facts.text: Signature experiences include sunrise yoga, cliff-edge dining, wellness journeys, stargazing and cultural experiences.
facts.excerpt: including sunrise yoga, cliff-edge dining, wellness journeys, stargazing and authentic cultural experiences

facts.text: Children can enjoy the Kids' Club and outdoor activities.
facts.excerpt: children can enjoy the Kids' Club and outdoor activities

facts.text: Jabal Akhdar is accessed via a mountain checkpoint and a 4WD vehicle is required.
facts.excerpt: As Jabal Akhdar is accessed via a mountain checkpoint, a 4WD vehicle is required.

facts.text: The resort is approximately 2.5 hours by car from Muscat International Airport.
facts.excerpt: The resort is approximately 2.5 hours by car from Muscat International Airport.

facts.text: Nearby, guests can explore hiking trails, traditional mountain villages, terraced farms and Jabal Akhdar's rose gardens during blooming season.
facts.excerpt: scenic hiking trails, traditional mountain villages, terraced farms and Jabal Akhdar’s famous rose gardens during blooming season

facts.text: The resort has five dining venues, including dining overlooking the canyon.
facts.excerpt: The resort offers five distinctive dining venues, ranging from international and regional cuisine to unforgettable dining experiences overlooking the dramatic canyon landscape.

facts.text: Nearby excursions include Nizwa Souk, Nizwa Fort and Bahla Fort.
facts.excerpt:
1. Nizwa Souk
2. Nizwa Fort
3. Bahla Fort

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel has the highest swimming pools, tennis court and stargazing platform in the Middle East.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has the highest swimming pools, tennis court, and stargazing platform in the Middle East.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes chasm-facing pool villas, majlis-style courtyards and a lantern-lit outdoor hookah space.
facts.excerpt: with chasm-facing pool villas, majlis-style courtyards, a lantern-lit outdoor hookah space

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler mentions rappelling and a spa with hammam rituals and frankincense oils.
facts.excerpt: whether dangling from a mountain while rappelling or relaxing in the impeccable spa with its energizing hammam rituals and fragrant frankincense oils

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel sits on the rim of a canyon in the Al-Hajar mountains.
facts.excerpt: Set in the sunburnt Al-Hajar mountains, on the rim of the Arabian Peninsula’s most outrageously beautiful canyon

facts.text: Check-in time.
facts.excerpt: Check-in begins at 3:00 pm, and check-out is by 12:00 noon.

facts.text: Described as one of the world's highest luxury resorts.
facts.excerpt: One of the world’s highest luxury resorts
